review: Visually inspected: distinct requested architectural metaphor; charcoal engraving on ivory; no visible text or literal technology.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: text-free chapter landscape illustration for the Common Obligations editorial website.
Style/medium: meticulous charcoal copperplate engraving, nineteenth-century architectural etching, surreal floating stone architecture in a vast mountainous landscape. Exquisitely fine crosshatching and stippling, no photography or smooth 3D rendering. Warm ivory paper #f1eee5 and charcoal ink only.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape, 1536x1024. Restrained monumental forms, strong depth with foreground architecture, middle fragments, distant mountains fading into paper. Architecture occupies most of scene with generous sky around upper edges. Atmospheric, thoughtful, imposing but not threatening. No image border.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, annotations, UI, watermarks. No literal technology, cameras, servers, computers, circuit boards. No colored threads or colored marks; connections will be added later as vector overlays. Do not depict real events. Avoid an ordinary city, repeated identical portals, and ornamental clutter.
Subject: A once continuous monumental stone span across a deep ravine, fractured in the center into three distinctly separated suspended stone fragments. At the break a short narrow pale replacement beam carefully bridges part of the gap, suggesting patient repair without hiding the fracture. The intact left and right sections remain substantial; exposed stone stratification and broken faces are clearly engraved. Strong low diagonal across the scene, distant mist and mountains. Human-free; no destruction spectacle, smoke, or catastrophe.
